normal_copy_route: planner -> OrderIntent v2 -> linked journal/CopyLedger -> RiskGateway -> ExecutionGateway.execute -> HyperliquidExecutionAdapter -> submit_copy_ioc -> reconcile_order -> canonical events/portfolio -> Result/journal ownership
p12_allocation_tests: 48/48; fixed-third algorithm unchanged; fault injection moved to IOC boundary
emergency_exception: emergency_stop: explicit network/account, owned-only cancellation; ordinary copy actions never use broad cancellation
recovery: Bounded query-only recovery; proved full fills reconstruct linked journal ownership. Recovered markets HOLD for that cycle. No unknown-order resubmission.
partial: Nonterminal/ambiguous order evidence retains reservation. Terminal IOC partial fills commit proven exposure; incomplete full-close retains legacy reconciliation HOLD.
capital_basis: Existing mode-aware USDC sizing/collateral basis retained; available collateral explicitly tagged with its DEX, not summed across pools or presented as total-wallet valuation.
persistence: Additive canonical tables in the existing execution journal database; parent envelope and child reservation linked in one transaction before submission.
validation_boundary: Mocked Hyperliquid clients only; not exchange-production certification
warnings: Existing POSIX permission test skipped on Windows
